name: AlphaX POS User Assignment
description: Where a person is allowed to sell. One row per branch they work at. A single row means they never see a picker; several means they choose a branch at login.

fields.label: Outlet
fields.description: Blank means any outlet in that branch.

fields.label: Terminal
fields.description: Blank means the machine decides, which is normally what you want — a person is assigned to a branch, not to a till.

fields.label: POS Profile
fields.description: Preferred profile. Only used if the terminal permits it; the terminal's own profile wins, because the profile drives accounts and belongs to the till, not the person.

fields.label: Default
fields.description: Where this person lands when they have more than one branch.
